issue.summary: Same supplier on 3 different payment terms across ERPs

plan.diagnosis: Delta Metals KG operates across 4 ERP instances (Oracle EBS, SAP A, NetSuite, SAP B) with inconsistent payment terms (NT60, Net 30, NET 45), creating working capital inefficiency and supplier confusion on USD 6,752,218 annual spend. The fragmented terms indicate lack of centralized master data governance and prevent capture of early payment discount opportunities or standardized cash flow planning.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct supplier negotiation to establish single standard payment term (target Net 45 with 2% 10 Net 45 early payment discount option) and obtain written confirmation from Delta Metals KG commercial contact

Update supplier master records in all 4 ERPs: Oracle EBS (Supplier Sites), SAP A (LFB1 ZTERM field), NetSuite (Vendor record Payment Terms), SAP B (LFB1 ZTERM field) to Net 45 standard term effective for all new POs
Configure and test early payment discount terms (2% 10 Net 45) in AP modules across Oracle EBS, SAP A/B (cash discount fields), and NetSuite; establish automated discount capture workflow
Implement master data policy requiring MDM approval for any payment term deviations; add Delta Metals KG to quarterly supplier master data audit checklist across all ERP instances
Train AP teams on new standardized terms and early payment discount capture process; communicate changes to requisitioners across all business units served by the 4 ERP systems

plan.expected_impact: Standardizing payment terms to Net 45 with 2% early payment discount on USD 6,752,218 annual spend could generate USD 135,044 in annual discount savings if 80% payment volume qualifies, plus improved cash flow predictability and reduced supplier inquiry overhead.
kpis: Payment term compliance rate across 4 ERPs (target 100% by Month 2)
Early payment discount capture rate (target 80% of invoices)
Actual discount dollars captured monthly vs. USD 135,044 annual target
Supplier master data consistency score for Delta Metals KG (binary: compliant/non-compliant)
Average days payable outstanding (DPO) for Delta Metals KG invoices
risks: Supplier may resist harmonization and demand shorter terms, eroding working capital benefit on USD 6.75M spend
Legacy open invoices under old terms (NT60, Net 30, NET 45) create dual-track AP processing complexity for 60-90 days
ERP master data synchronization failures across 4 systems may reintroduce term mismatches without ongoing monitoring
Business units accustomed to NT60 (60-day terms) may face cash flow adjustments under Net 45 standard
AP staff may fail to capture early payment discounts without workflow automation and training reinforcement
erp_actions: Oracle EBS: Update supplier site payment terms to 'NET 45' and configure 2% 10 Net 45 discount terms in AP > Suppliers > Sites > Payment Details
SAP A: Change LFB1-ZTERM to 'Z045' (Net 45) for Delta Metals KG vendor-company code records; update cash discount baseline days to 10 and percentage to 2.0%
SAP B: Change LFB1-ZTERM to 'Z045' (Net 45) for Delta Metals KG vendor-company code records; update cash discount baseline days to 10 and percentage to 2.0%
NetSuite: Update Vendor record for Delta Metals KG with Terms = 'Net 45' and configure '2% 10 Net 45' in Discounts tab
Coupa: Add payment term validation rule flagging any Delta Metals KG PO with terms other than Net 45 for procurement review before approval
All ERPs: Add 'Payment Terms Standardization - 2026' note to vendor master comments field with implementation date and owner contact
